text: Support for adventure and learning, with a constraint. Pages are drawn independently, so a page-end question must not promise a detail the next variant may not deliver; that is exactly the light/sound cross-page contradiction PROSE_PRODUCTION_GUIDE records. Writable safely as generic hooks ('Ama nasıl?') plus an answersHook opening on every variant of the following beat. Bedtime: only pages 2-4 and soft; never on the last two pages, and 'acaba'/'?' endings are already banned for episode ends by CalmEnding.
